checks.name: THE ONE THAT ACTUALLY FAILED: an unrecognisable file name is refused
checks._why: Matrixify rejected the first canary in one second with 'Cannot understand the uploaded file'. The bodies were correct byte for byte; the file NAME was the defect, because a CSV has no tab name and Matrixify reads the sheet type off the name. Nothing checked the envelope, so 38 green assertions sat on top of a file that could not be imported.
checks.expect_failure: a file name Matrixify cannot recognise is refused
